timestamp_corruption.description: All started_at timestamps are 2026-05-23 (from session context date) while completed_at timestamps are 2026-05-22 (real system clock). This is the known anti-pattern: ORCH writing timestamps from session context instead of running (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime(). Actual work times computed from completed_at deltas between consecutive steps — a lower-bound estimate that excludes queue time.
timestamp_corruption.mitigation: Rule adjustments skipped — cannot compute accurate work-time variances with corrupted started_at timestamps. ORCH must use real system clock for all timestamps going forward.
